items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: Yes, he's, uh, he was a trombone player. And a good one, and he's now in Purdue, Kentucky, and he's, uh, teaching trombone in one of the schools.

ctx.x: I don't remember so many names, but I remember Carlisle Evans because he was a piano player. He was a good one.
What about Nat's story? Do you remember him?
Yes, he's, uh, he was a trombone player. And a good one, and he's now in Purdue, Kentucky, and he's, uh, teaching trombone in one of the schools. Nathaniel Storyans.
